summary: Scope-owned, import-safe capability declarations for the relation domain, laid out as backend/(family|dialects)/<namespace>/relation.py. Each module exports a SEGMENT (CapabilitySegment, Domain.RELATION) holding information, policy rules or changes, and each dialect has a _scope.py giving its Scope (e.g. ibis-sqlite). Declarations include Ibis seeded exact-count sample as UNSUPPORTED, resource-read CSV dialect fallback, and SQLite IMPORT_INTO storage limits.
key_classes: CapabilitySegment (from core.capabilities) — SEGMENT objects declared per scope; not defined here
Scope/Dialect — _scope.py SCOPE constants naming backend and dialect
extension_points: Add a new dialect directory with _scope.py defining SCOPE
CapabilityInformation/CapabilityPolicyRule with CapabilityKey over RKEY_* operation keys
